author: The Critical Drinker
description: This one really is a special case - a man who crashed and burned not once, but twice in his career. From 80s heart throb to 90's burnout, the miraculous career resurrection of the 2000s to his ultimate fate as a homeless, broke old man, the story of Mickey Rourke truly is a wild ride.
title: Double Crash And Burn - The Mickey Rourke Story
